name: Groundwork
$nameNote: Placeholder. Not trademark-cleared, and not searched against any register. It is a common English noun and almost certainly in use by somebody; treat it as a working title only.
$serviceLinesNote: preventive.screening — 'age- and risk-appropriate screening, guidance shaped to the person rather than a generic checklist' — is deliberately NOT claimed, and this is the one place where the area catalogue and its own safeguards pull against each other. Shaping guidance to a person's age and risk is a screening judgment about that person, and no_screening_claim forbids the product from making one. What Groundwork actually does is show the published guidance in full, with the body that issued it and the year, and leave the person to decide what to raise. That is a smaller thing than the catalogue describes, so the line is left unticked rather than redefined quietly.
$localesNote: English only. The Spanish helpline rows below are real lines that answer in Spanish; the interface is not translated, and listing 'es' in this array would claim that it is.
$vocabularyNote: There is no urge here and nothing that behaves like one: a dental cleaning does not arrive at 11pm on a Tuesday. There is no lapse either, and inventing one would be the cruellest thing this product could do — a check somebody has not had is a date, and the reasons are usually childcare, shift work or money rather than willpower. 'target' is a date a clinic gave the person. There is no primary metric, because a percentage-complete on a checklist the product did not compile would be a score against a standard nobody set.

helplines.name: 988 Línea de Prevención del Suicidio y Crisis

$helplineNote: One organisation line was removed before shipping because it could not be verified from this environment: CDC-INFO (1-800-232-4636), CDC-INFO (español) (1-800-232-4636). See design/helplines-to-verify.md. A wrong number on a health screen is worse than no number, so it is absent rather than unchecked. Only 988 and 911, which are fixed national codes, remain.

platformCapabilities.$note: Reminders are scheduled locally from dates the person typed, and their text never varies — see sensitive_notifications_off. Nothing is imported from a health record, a pharmacy, an insurer or a state registry, so the record is only ever as complete as the person made it, and the copy says that instead of implying a coverage it does not have. There is no rescue flow to run offline; this programme has no moment that needs one.

proposedArchetypes.reason: What has been done and what is coming, owned by the person it describes. Already proposed in supplement.archetypes.json and shared with cancer. Here it also carries person_owns_record: the export and the hard delete live on the record screen itself rather than only in Settings, because a record you can only delete from somewhere else is not one you own.
